notes.title: Magicraft 1.1 Update Notice
notes.content:
Dear great magicians, hello~ 

After the official release, we took a short break. After the break, we started a new development, on the one hand, we are making the content and ideas that we have already decided, on the other hand, we are organizing and discussing the feedback we have collected, and optimizing the content that we have discussed and passed to fill in the game. One phase of content production has been completed and will be updated today.
Please see below for the content of this update:

[h2]New Monsters:[/h2]
This 1.1 Version Content updates a total of 9 types of monsters, which are new elite monsters in Chapter 5 and new mini-monsters in Chapter 2 respectively.
[b]Added elite monsters:Worm Nest Overlord
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/e223c1d190b25526d6234b0017ec07af78cc87ee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/7ec3211367b8043cc335bdbe257b481f377b5518.gif[/img]
You'll need to defeat its “minions” before you can take on the Worm Nest Overlord Worm Nest corp.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/6507b14eea6a0fbe5c90ab2af1313f9071aadc34.gif[/img]
In addition to the Chapter 5 monsters, we also find a new race in Chapter 2—[b]Skeleton Monster[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/3e8bee3941528c2c6d019643ab5aba7548a8340c.gif[/img]
[h2]
New Spells:[/h2]
A total of 7 new spells have been added this time
[b]New Spell Projectile:[/b]
Dimension Walker,Releasing it consumes all remaining mana, and each point of mana translates into 2 points of damage as well as 0.01s duration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/5cfec04929e4a17065df06880cab5fd0cbbf35e3.gif[/img]
[b]New Spell Summon:[/b]
Self destructing insect nest，Takes 6% damage per 1.2 of life cap, summons 1 self destructing insect on injury and 6 self destructing insects on death.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/16d696c36ac430eb0b244bd4e13ac49db705093c.gif[/img]
[b]New Spell Unique:[/b]
Half way transmission:After half the spell's duration, the spell transmission to a random location.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/318bd808ccd419e0723fdf7fed856dd681ecf1cb.gif[/img]
Reverse casting method:Spells cast are sent from -180°.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/d1b521d589d7b4ff2c6ea2b4d7ea8feba09ca061.gif[/img]
Subjective delay time:Spell flight speed x 50% and increased duration based on reduced speed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/bcca4e0f743312686e0d160695f4f484ac7ed440.gif[/img]
Remote casting:Cast spells are cast in the direction of the mouse from the vicinity of the mouse's location and ignore obstacles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/65f038ee2ce434d00c852bbf7e5a5d84bd6fdc4b.gif[/img]
[b]New Spell Passive:[/b]
Magic energy conversion device:The staff stops the magic return and boosts the efficiency of the rear slot recharge based on the magic return value.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/29d67bf311198f7b169018a319dc06cbfe597f34.gif[/img]

[h2]New Relics＆New Relic Function:[/h2]
A total of six new relics have been added this time
[b]New Relics:[/b]
Second brain:Select 1 additional relic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/e8ef4ecd3c8cfde949a1a4df3f1a823161ce6a59.gif[/img]
Scholar's glasses:Choose 1 additional spell.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/972e0da1490f1b2e477ee98d86f548ba490fba65.gif[/img]
Cardiotonic:Life room revenue increases by 30%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/0eb6b6674ac52710a15893c12f287444d57c307e.gif[/img]
Summoning Wealth Bell:Coin house revenue increases by 30%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/47da3c11139f607bc537ca850a49bc73a0d347c5.gif[/img]
Druid's Horn:Added as a unique relic for the Summoning Set.
Bird beak mask:Added as a unique relic for Pharmacist Set.

[b]New Relic Function:[/b]
Function①:
Relic Series Function,Five new RelicSeries Functions have been added.After collecting the corresponding relics,Additional gains can be obtained.Separately:Collected all Merlin set,Collected allSoul Bone Set,Collected allTree Spirit Set,Collected allknight suit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/181834252050c672c9dd1ce477c01366e81fcd24.gif[/img]
Function②:
Single Relic Appearance, Click To Display/Hide,Clicking on the list of relics on the right allows you to show or turn off the appearance of individual relics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/780ed0c933e6dae5832d82f024d30cae83fd00ea.gif[/img]

[h2]New Set:[/h2]
This time, 1 new set has been added:Pharmacist Set,Number of potion slots +3, 1 potion for every 2 levels passed, 7 points of blood restored for every potion consumed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/220c7bdc1e85360f4f29c8ddcf74c6f3a395e472.gif[/img]
Summoner Set Update:Summoner Set removes Relic “Emberheart” and adds Relic “Druid's Horn”.Within a certain range,Inflicts 75% of your character's life limit in seconds on enemies,Heals friendlies for 25% of the character's life limit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/40bf233b29fc9a1948ce37f0c8da34276a7e0fcc.gif[/img]

[h2]New Functions:[/h2]
A total of 4 new Functions have been added to this update based on feedback collected from player suggestions.
Functions①：Damage Statistics
You can view the current room damage stats or global damage stats at any time during the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/7c03ffee0b775a89b678228695704fc1c4355ea3.gif[/img]
Functions②:Summon Remover
It can be used at any time during the game to clear all current summons with a single click.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/4897ebea95e3f874303144e52354a69339a65f2f.gif[/img]
Functions③:Recycler
Appears in the Abyss of Antiquity preparation room in Chapter 4 and can convert its own spells, relics, and potions into gold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/838979ead7f6fbacb66764dc98e391b172cc62b2.gif[/img]
Functions④:Training Ground Relics Optional
This update adds Relics Optional Functions to Training Ground, allowing magicians to match better builds in Training Ground.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/bce24ce674d23de3828548eade442ba7f0de7ad2.png[/img]
While we continue to develop on the PC side, we are also actively cooperating with our colleagues in the porting team for the advancement of the mobile side of Magicraft, especially the optimization issues that you are focusing on.
Next, we will continue the development of new content and complete the content we have already identified. At the same time, we will also try to fulfill everyone's new expectations for the game as much as we can. After the development of the envisioned content is completed, we will move on to the evaluation and planning of Endless Mode and other content, so we hope you can give us some more time.

The above is the brand new content that we have created in this 1.1 version, we hope magicians can enjoy it and experience it more after the 1.1 version is online, and give us more suggestions. We will continue to listen to your ideas and respond to your expectations~!

notes.title: Magicraft Developer Log 10
notes.content:
Magicraft Developer Log 10

Dear great magicians, hello~ 
When the official version was released, we announced we would continue developing it. On the one hand, we will produce the content and ideas that have been determined, and on the other hand, we will organize and discuss the feedback we collected, and optimize and update the content. 
So in this developer log, we will focus on introducing the new content and optimization we have made in 1.1 version, please see the introduction~

[h2]Development of new content[/h2]
After 1.0 version, we still haven't stopped developing spells, relics, and other content.
During this period, we have developed 7 new spells, 6 relics, and 6 new wands. After the official launch of version 1.1, hope that the great magicians can experience more~

[h3]New monsters[/h3]
There are 9 new monsters in 1.1 version that will meet the great magicians.
First, here is the new elite monster in Chapter 5: Worm Nest Overlord.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/e223c1d190b25526d6234b0017ec07af78cc87ee.png[/img]

But before encountering the Worm Nest Overlord, you need to pass the test of the "followers" of it~

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/1376d175dc8f31270e506ef60cba3657d0e64aa7.png[/img]

In addition to the above 5 monsters, we also found a new species, the Skeleton, in Chapter 2 - Eternal Fortress.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/e134228a8f3f2239779d02b15501c18988c004b6.png[/img]


[h3]New Spells[/h3]
To ensure that the great magicians are fresh about the new content, this introduction still selects some representative spells
Spell ①: Summoning
Yes, we have made a new summoning spell after the Giant Troll. According to the news from our hero, he realized this spell was based on the skills of the new elite monsters in the Ancient Throne.
Spell ②: Unique
We have added some unique spells in the 1.0 version, hoping that everyone can use these spells to develop more interesting builds. Through the subsequent  situation of everyone's clearance, we noticed that these unique spells are indeed helpfuland provide more ideas for everyone. So in the update of 1.1 version, there are also new unique spells waiting for the great magicians' wonderful ideas.
At the same time, we'd like to explain again how to obtain this type of unique spell:
Unlock the Carrion Eater through research at Lien. After unlocking it, you will have a chance to encounter a group of Carrion Eater in Chapter 3. Throw away an useless spell next to the Abyss. After Carrion Eater collects it, a random unique spell will be returned.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/8d956daf2380f535deba20ab9988cfa6c831be73.gif[/img]

Spells ③: Passive Spells
We have also added the Boundary Stone spells in 1.0 version, hoping that you can expand moe charging builds by freely changing the back slot. However, we found that players seemed to be limited by the lack of charging efficiency. As such, there will be a new spell in this update that can solve this problem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/251d9b79cac643bf5e8eeab295e502b8368b1359.png[/img]


We hope that the birth of these relics in 1.1 version can help everyone build their builds faster when challenging higher level of difficulty. Therefore, their effects are all related to the increase in benefits (which means they will be rarer). But don't worry, the harder they are to obtain, the greater the benefits.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/7dc7868fa08ad76f7d4601bed64fdf88771eb16e.png[/img]

In addition, we also made two new relic functions based on the suggestions from players.
Function ①: Series relic effect
To make relics more interactive, we have unified the classification of all relics. There are currently 5 series of relics and several other scattered relics. After this update, players will get extra benefits if they collect any series of relics in the same round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/1ccb32694ccebdca55703f04de7ea86628602887.png[/img] 

Function ②: Hide/display the single relic
In the previous version, only Hunter's Talisman and Close Observations can be turned off, but we have also received suggestions for other relics to be turned off at will. Therefore, we tried to implement this function in this update. Once 1.1 version is launched, you will be able to close or display the single relic by clicking the icon of the list of relics on the right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/631e8cbf98eac0a81b8ee2aed7751f752a36478a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/3946324b7067afd1557b248d018d2025ee33d1cd.gif[/img]
 

[h3]New set[/h3]
During the development of the game, we realized that, no matter how new spells or relics are added, different builds are derived only through different spells. So, can we design some new content to promote the birth of a new build whose core is not dependent on spells? After continuous design rejection, this set was finally born.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/f5674cad6e75cc5b89cb014ce2008315614e8155.png[/img]

[h2]【Optimize the game experience】[/h2]
After the 1.0 version, we once again collected and sorted out everyone's suggestions. After many discussions, we determined the production of the following content. These optimizations can be experienced in 1.1 version~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/118e6b9a11d865aca79437ef67de6199ce5f4785.png[/img]

[h3]New research function: Damage statistics[/h3]
At first, we received feedback that they wanted to check the damage caused by each spell in the final summary. However, after discussion, we decided to apply this function directly to the entire round. After the 1.1 version update, you will be able to unlock this function through research and check your current spell damage and total damage at any time during the game.

[h3]New research function: summon remover[/h3]
Regarding the summons, we also received some high-volume feedback. For example, when there are too many summons, the game will be stuck and you cannot enter the next room, and even you cannot find the drops. Therefore, we made a summon remover. When you encounter the above troubles, you can remove them with one click.

[h3]New research function: recycler[/h3]
Through observation, we found that although the number of spell bans has increased, some great magicians still find it difficult to successfully achieve the build they envisioned during the adventure, especially since we are constantly developing new spells. Therefore, we have specially created a recycling function in this update. When the great magicians reach the fourth chapter, you can convert the spells, relics, and potions that you don’t need into gold coins through the recycling device to help everyone better complete builds.

[h3]New function of the training ground: Relic selection[/h3]
The addition of relics selection in the training ground is also one of the most popular functions since the game was launched. We have specially developed it this time. In the future, you can better develop and study your builds in the training ground~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/bce24ce674d23de3828548eade442ba7f0de7ad2.png[/img]


[h2]【Subsequent plans】[/h2]
We will continue to develop new content and functions continue to enhance the optimization of the game, and strive for the smoothness of the barrage of Magic Craft, which can be better and better.
In more than one year of companionship with the great magicians, I believe that everyone can also feel our concern and attention to player suggestions. We will try our best to meet everyone's new expectations for the game within our capabilities. Therefore, we hope that all great magicians can experience 1.1 version more after it is launched, and give us more suggestions and feedback.
After the development of the content is completed, we will enter the planning and development of new content such as endless mode. Hope greay magicians can give us more time.

Well, this is the end of developer log! If you have any suggestions, you can put them in the comment section, or you can go to our official Discord community! 
We are waiting for your joining~

notes.title: Version 1.0 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hi all dear great magicians, 
On November 2 last year, the Early Access version of Magicraft met you for the first time. After a year, we are finally going to move to 1.0 version! During this year, your suggestions and feedback have provided us with a lot of motivation and inspiration. We have gone through three large-scale updates, and also have encountered many development problems during this period. Although we tried our best, it was difficult to take everything into account. But fortunately, all of you never gave up and always supported us. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/898675014b1e814ed43c023a02e9e969ff3dd481.jpg[/img]

Compared with the greenness and inadequacy of the EA stage, 1.0 version has made great progress in filling and optimizing the content. In 1.0 version, there will be 5 chapters, 100 spells, 100 wands, 9 sets, 80 relics, 60 curses, 35 potions, and 234 monsters. We hope that after this update, "Magicraft" can still bring you joy and be a game that you want to play in your leisure~ 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/1884dd5ef2abd34c564c2226214f1c2d21583fe4.png[/img]

Now, let us introduce the update content. Hope you like it: 

[b][h3]New Chapter [/h3][/b]

[b]Chapter 4-Abyss of Antiquity & Chapter 5-Ancient Throne [/b]

Compared with EA version, in subsequent updates, we have made Chapter Abyss of Antiquity with a very different scene style, as well as Chapter Ancient Throne with Boss rush mode that will be updated in 1.0 version. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/1b0b36989e04f005ab989d425006374eb926c5ce.png[/img]

[b]Chapter 4 - Abyss of Antiquity [/b]
Influenced by Abyss of Antiquity environment, the monsters here have a more horrible appearance and more dangerous attack methods, such as void creatures that can enter the void to avoid attacks, and flying creatures that can absorb magic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/6a30516621f718d23970ee7f559074ca4598b525.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/0db3a2d4d6af3ffdbdc29125a5641aaa7b26b2f9.gif[/img]

Of course, the most dangerous creature is the boss "Deep Sea Master". Looking at his name, he seems to have excellent water control ability. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/baf2a902bc92a997bd31bf6d6c906b9ea4810e2e.gif[/img]

[b]Chapter 5-Ancient Throne [/b]
When magicians successfully defeat the monsters of Abyss of Antiquity, you will enter Chapter 5-Ancient Throne. 
The Ancient Throne is the heart of the ancient gods, so you can see the flesh and blood of the ancient gods everywhere, and also various horror scenes. Considering that magicians can generally complete your build in the first four chapters, the simple difficulty can no longer satisfy the refreshing experience. 
Therefore, we have made the fifth chapter a boss rush chapter with a series of battles with bosses to improve the refreshing experience! This menas, in Chapter 5, you will be besieged by many different leaders. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/7099efe734a018b09576b71e203c1a29a12acd7c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/005552afd5b66096b7bc12592f6b47e82879d7ef.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/7ac5b58d0c824ac94ef7a897942f856f96145fb4.gif[/img]

However, magicians don't need to worry! we have prepared the following new content to strengthen your abilities: 

[b][h3]New Spells [/h3][/b]
[b]New Unique Spells[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/dca7fbf4ce31308b73af6df1117463e7d575a3f4.png[/img]

In the earliest version, we only had one unique spell called the Enchanting Coin. This is our whim outside the development of normal spells. In the subsequent development, we have a lot of unconventional ideas, and specially designed the study of rotten tongue clusters for this purpose. By feeding it spells, you can exchange a random unique spell. Hope you can use these unique spells to develop more interesting builds. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/a52ad49fb98d204bab6a0ba8c9288093f053ede5.png[/img]

[b]Connect Spells[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/0f655451d3896757926a8926d8f67079266f12b0.png[/img]
The principle of connecting spells is to link the right spell by shoting the left spell. 
At first, we had an active spell called Lead, which was similar to connecting effect. Because of its special trigger mechanism, we received many play needs to increase such spells, so we made four new connect spells in version 0.8. 
For these four spells, we recast the underlying code of the whole game. We almost lost the promised update at that time. Fortunately, we finally caught up. Well, in the development of Version 1.0, we have also made a new connect spell, waiting for all magicians. 

[b]Boundary Stone Spell[/b]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/2c8164ef3122cba8870f9f503c7d7479da8fd104.png[/img]
We have noticed that magicians have a lot of ideas about charging wands with  the rear slots, but due to the number of charging wands, the build path has been difficult to expand, which bings the birth of Boundary Stone spells. After equipping the Boundary Stone Spell, all slots on the right side of Boundary Stone spells will become charging slots. 

In addition, there are also interesting spells such as the Spell Fall, which can change spell attack mode, waiting for magicians to experience~ 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/c45878b4ff1577214b85d5a45822c88a00cc90a7.png[/img]

[b]New Relics [/b]
Of course, the new journey will also be supported by new relics. 
In this update, there will be Explorer's Hats with additional room choices, as well as Ward Charm that are probable of eliminating curses to help great magicians face any difficulties. In addition, there will be Colorful Cloak to replace crystals, which can make your spells more gorgeous. If none of these can satisfy you, it doesn't matter. The Reboot Key may help you restart all over again. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/50fa81064e5680a31194ab57672c0f5d63461daf.png[/img]


Brand-new Set 
Next is the new set part. The new Melee Mage set comes from the suggestion that magicians want a melee mage set with a dodge function. The remaining three sets come from other worlds to help us resist the invasion of monsters. They are: Bi'an set, Reaper set and Bing set respectively. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/d4e926a8e88574220f9ea817571215db9faf0f4a.png[/img]

Melee Mage set: It comes with its own relic Swordsman Cloak, has a certain melee ability, and can dodge displacement through the space bar. 
Use Evil Slayer Sword to defeat 300 enemies to unlock the set; 

Bi'an set: It comes with the spell Bi'an Flying Sword and the relic. The flying Sword can automatically fly out with the shot of active spell. Use the spacebar to trigger Sword-return and call back all the flying swords. 
[b]Use Sword of Judgment to defeat any leader to unlock the set; [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/ac2ab8104fd6e6a8261c6faca683705ce4782071.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/7a674345eb1e33de680fe116a8b7cc49e9a4c03a.gif[/img]

Reaper Set: It can double the number of venom layers (1.0 version cancels the upper limit of venom layers) and automatically synthesize spells that can be synthesized in the backpack every time you enter the door. 
[b]Use the Venom Crysatal to stack venom layers to 1500 to unlock the set; [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/be8624ed35ffbac54c0c389fb3b15de54a739d04.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/94db416f986ca49d3b8d58b6555d249b5b93f0d8.gif[/img]

Bing set: It comes with Bing's arrow and relic Default. The Arrow will release 4 powerful big arrows every 50 times. Use space bar can release Butt Slam with strong move ability, and Butt Slam can cause damage to the enemy's life. After unlocking any 6 sets, the Bing set will be automatically unlocked. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/64ba55c188daf6a7689ff9d0f75973d14bcc76a7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/eb3ec65d7382e530f7b0cd31443d14ab8e17b63e.gif[/img]

[b]EA version player bonus[/b]
In order to thank players who have been supporting us since EA version, we hereby give you EA version player bonus. Players who have game archive with more than 2 hours before 1.0 version update, can directly choose one of three sets to unlock the cooperation set in version 1.0~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/b8a26584750fd93741822479702f1f46977ba72a.jpg[/img]

[b]New skin [/b]
Also, there are more appearances in this update! 
We are very delightful to invite "Old Tomato" and "66" to cooperate with us this time.The cooperation skin will also be launched in 1.0 version on the same day! In addition, our bilibili TV skin will also join the journey as a new skin~ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/b1779da2fd14cdbd870a53cb643e78c13e1eacc0.png[/img]

[b][h3]All New Features in NPCs[/h3][/b]
In order to provide a better growth experience, in addition to the regular addition, we have also made the following functions~ 

[b]NPC Lyon - New Research [/b]
●Resource Converter
After activation, magic crystal, ancient blood and chaotic core can be exchanged from each other. 
Note: Resource conversion will be lossy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/faeeff4e42ad784bd936b9bddb48e5e1b1a957bd.jpg[/img]

●Shortcut room
After activation, you will randomly encounter four-in-one room with spells, relics, blood limit, coin in the game. After clearing all monsters, you will get one of each reward, and the overall progress will be reduced by 4 levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/de4f561d3dc5f81144893dfce872b4e8a9231edf.jpg[/img]

●New Scarecrow:
After activation, Scarecrow will add Strongest Hit and Max DPS record. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/c0be116105ba4df304f299b62387733600a85c06.jpg[/img]

[b]Monster Girl Lilian - New Spell packs and Functions [/b]
●Spell Lock
After activation, you can lock spells when selecting in battle progress. The locked spell will always appear in subsequent spell selections, and will no longer appear after unlocking/being selected. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/075dba7bc996f05e95ec490749cd5cd127f9ac57.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/9918d3d6d3b067c880b1e5d9207bb056cdbaeba8.png[/img]

●Monster Girl Sense
Automatically activated after unlocking both NPC Lilian and Gina. It can increase the number of spells you can ban and the maximum number will be 44. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/0df8e82db7dbf33d348bc53913e73570428f50f8.jpg[/img]

Art Iteration 
In addition to game content update, we have also optimized and iterated the art content, hoping that the game can become more exquisite. 

[b][h3]Scene[/h3][/b]
In terms of game scenes, we have optimized the detailed performance of the scene, including the increase in the thickness of the wall, the appearance change and shadow adjustment of the building, which will be available to everyone in 1.0 version. We hope that these optimizations can bring you a deeper sense of immersion. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/515d35292a47297f2e15a6e66a4738e9a9f45533.png[/img]

[b]Special Room[/b]
In the design of some special rooms, we have carried out separate art scene design, so that these special scenes have their own visual effects. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/437b51d7aa90e1e8abf1bd1d3aaf17938973af72.jpg[/img]

[b]UI Adjustment[/b]
In addition to the art optimization of scenes, we also didn't forget UI design of different interfaces. In 1.0 version: 
The spell selection box will appear in different colors according to rarity, and players can more easily distinguish the rarity of spells.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/dc81b86c26cd138eb6c2a47e31e2f5a6eaf372e2.jpg[/img]

At the same time, Boss's HP UI has also been iterative. We wonder if such Bosses are more oppressive~

notes.title: Developer's Log 09 for "Magicraft"
notes.content:
Dear great magicians, hello, everyone~ 
 In the middle of last month, we launched the internal test of version 1.0 and invited 300 players to test our current content. 
 Presumably, the great wizards who did not participate in the test are also quite curious about our development progress and the content of the test. Therefore, in this developer log, we will not only introduce some new content, but also extract some of the information in the internal test to share with you. Without further ado, please refer to the introduction~ 


[h3][b][h3][Development of new content] [/h3][/b][/h3]
 The construction of our fifth chapter has been completed, and the finishing work has begun. 
 At this stage, we have 100 spells, and there are 80 relics. These spells and relics will help the great magicians fight against 23 leaders in the future. 


[b]● Add some spells [/b]
 In this issue of developer logs, we have selected three representative spells that were developed last month to introduce to you. 
 Spell 1 Connection: About the birth of joint spells, but there are many more details. Since the launch of the conjunction spell, we have seen the possibilities created by the conjunction spell, so this time we have also developed a new joint spell, hoping that more routines can be explored by great magicians in the future. 
 Spell 2 Crystals: At present, crystals are known to be toxic, thunder, deceleration, freezing and ignition. In fact, there were no plans to develop such spells before, until we received suggestions from many great magicians who wanted to add more bobo dyeing, so we designed a new crystal, and the new crystal performed very well in our tests! At the same time, at this stage of development, we have iterated the logic of the whole crystal spell. In 1.0, crystal spells will bring a higher upper limit to everyone's output! 
 Spell 3 assistance category: After trying to review the spell usage and staff preferences when everyone has passed customs since 0.6, we noticed that although there are a total of four staffs, in fact, only 2-3 are actually used. Moreover, in more cases, other staffs are used as spell grid reserves. Therefore, we have designed a new assistive spell, which can help you make better use of other staffs through its unique characteristics (different from guardian scepters and resonance runes). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/d8b13f31fb63a6689696b8259ef11be691df7961.png[/img]

[b]Part of the new chapter [/b]
 In the middle of last month, after completing the foundation of Chapter 5, we began to make more refined adjustments and optimizations to Chapter 5. 
 For example, map expansion. We consider that the main content of Chapter 5 is each leader. If the map is not large enough, whether it is the model of the leader, their respective combat performance, or the movement and dodge of the great magicians, they will be constrained. Therefore, we have expanded the scope of the map of each level to varying degrees. 
 Meanwhile, since this is the final chapter and the backdrop of this level is set in the heartland of the Ancient God, we have refined or iterated the modeling of each boss to varying degrees based on the original models, to ensure that everyone can experience a stronger sense of immersion and oppression through them~ 
 Finally, it is about the skill creation of each leader. In the original version, although each new leader also had a gorgeous attack method, more of it was just randomly switched between different attack methods. Although this is feasible, it is indeed unsatisfactory in terms of playability. So we continued to work overtime last month to add new stages and attack methods to them. Although the difficulty has also been improved, I believe that a better attack mod will bring you a better game experience~ 

[h3][b] [About the test] [/b][/h3]
 Next, I would like to share with you some news about the internal test started last month. 
 The great magicians recruited this time are very powerful and have given us great help. Up to now, our internal test has received a total of 720+ test feedback (BUG + suggestions + type BUG questions). 
 According to the feedback, we have located a lot of bugs that were difficult to find before, as well as detailed problems. At present, 400+ fixes have been completed, and 20+ version iterations have been made. 
 In addition to restoration, we have also made adjustments to some of the contents that everyone has been thinking about, such as some spells/relics/potions that are too chicken ribs: 
 1 Change of poisonous liquid crystal stone: the poisoning time after the poisonous liquid crystal stone hits the unit is shortened, but the upper limit of the number of layers is canceled; 
 2 Magic tail bone change: the damage is changed from a fixed 10 to 10% of the health value of the deceased enemy; 
 3 Unlock the potion change: Now unlocking the potion can unlock all the treasure chests in the room, including the spike box and the curse box. 
 About the optimization of the game experience: 
 1 The drop radius of the reward for picking up gold coins is from 2->1.5, and now it is easier to pick up gold coins; 
 2 Chapter 4 Bubu Puzzle Game, changed from 9 pictures to 6 pictures; 
 3 Chapter 4 The square of the route connection has become larger. Now it is not easy to have the need to reconnect due to operational errors and out of the grid when connecting. 
 Since most of the content needs to be kept confidential for the time being, the great magicians to explore after the official version is opened, so at present, we can only share some changes to the old content with you. As for the new content, please believe that we will definitely tune it more and strive to let the great magicians experience a stable and fun official version!  

[h3][b] [About the official version] [/b][/h3]
 After nearly a year of polishing, it is finally time to update 1.0. Although I have made a lot of psychological expectations, I still feel panic when I share with you the news that we are about to leave the EA stage. 
 Since the launch of EA, everyone's support for us and the BUG and feedback provided have been of great help to us, but the feedback we can give has always been limited. 
 In the past six months, we have not updated any major versions, and only uploaded patches in the first few months of this year. Although it is essentially to allow everyone to play a more complete version of the game at once, it still makes the great magicians wait for a long time. I sincerely apologize to everyone here. I'm sorry to keep the great magicians waiting for a long time! 
 In the following period, we will release part of the content of Chapter 5 for the great magicians to be updated until November. Yes, we will update to the official version in November this year. For the specific update date, please pay more attention to our official account. All subsequent related news will be synchronized in the official account~ 

Well, this is the developer log of this issue to say goodbye to everyone! If you have any suggestions, you can put them in the comment section, or you can go to our official position: B station, QQ group and Discord community! 
We are waiting for your joining~ 

Discord Community: https://discord.com/invite/magicraft-1029926808516309093

notes.title: Developer's Log 08 for "Magicraft"
notes.content:
Dear Magicians,
Greetings to you all!
First, I would like to wish you all a Happy Mid-Autumn Festival, with joy and family reunions! 
After the greetings, it's time to share our development progress. After a month of hard work, our total number of spells has successfully exceeded 100, and the number of relics has also reached 80. Additionally, we've made progress in code upgrades and scene optimizations. In the upcoming updated version, we will have a loading animation, and the campsite has become more vibrant compared to version 0.8.
Here's a detailed introduction:

[h3][b]【Development of New Content】[/b][/h3]
In terms of new content development, we have filled in regular content that everyone is concerned about, such as spells, relics, and curses. Besides, the most important thing is still about the construction work of Chapter 5. Without further ado, let's dive into the details:

[b]●New Spells[/b]
Last month, we created 3 new spells.
As the number of spells increases, even if we try to expand the number of spells that can be disabled, we are still concerned that you may encounter the dilemma of not being able to increase the level of the most critical spell in your builds during your adventure. Therefore, we have tried to design a new spell that will solve this problem for you~
At the same time, with the addition of various spells, there is an increasing demand for the addition of summoning spells. The new summoning spell, although late, has arrived!
As for the newly added third spell, it is a type that has never appeared before. The detailed spell effects will need to be experienced by Magicians in the official version later. Let me whisper to you that it is related to healing~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/8ca2d3771af0a06ab2fb75980a518b73ca8b84c9.png[/img]

[b]●New Relics[/b]
Due to last month's development focus being more on the boss production in Chapter 5, the new relics introduced this time will be slightly less compared to the previous developer log. Despite the smaller number, the effects of each relic are very practical. And based on the effect of the relics, we have also designed very appropriate icons and the display effect of the relics equipment on the body. You can guess their specific functions according to the pictures below~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/37df56e3a4feb073d4a3d70fd0470d4eb06174a3.png[/img]

[b]●New Chapter Content[/b]
For battle experience, last month we designed two new bosses, one wrapped in flames or lightning (left in the image), and the other wrapped in white but seemingly controlled by someone else (right in the image). After seeing the appearance of these two bosses, can you imagine what attack methods they might use?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/3b68dc2b839d0e75be4b99859d5ff17f6fed6104.png[/img]

[h3][b]【Game Experience Optimization】[/b][/h3]
In terms of game experience optimization, we have made adjustments in the past month in two aspects: gameplay experience and performance optimization. Moreover, most of the optimization content this time is related to the suggestions and feedback provided by all our players and their daily gaming experience. We really listen to advice, so please provide us with more feedback. We will take it seriously and consider feasibility!

[b]●New Appearance of Camp[/b]
We have always felt that the camp was quite sparse. Although more and more NPCs were rescued as the adventure progressed, the only difference at a glance was the number of people rescued. Moreover, it is difficult for new players to quickly understand the role of each NPC. So, last month, we renovated the camp and the areas where NPCs are stationed have undergone different changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/6827fc024d108ea601eb0174b5865ae94e0b72bf.png[/img]

[b]●Small Tips Signboard[/b]
In previous versions, we placed some tips or tricks about the game in the【Manual】, which can be viewed by pressing "ESC" in the game. But in subsequent observations, we found that this method is not fast or convenient, and if not specifically stated, most players would not be aware that these prompts are included in the【Manual】. Therefore, we made a signboard and placed it in the 0-0 room. After entering the room, you can find it on the right side of the map~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/ab936a4ebe5a494ef37efa5c1683659442dc1dd9.png[/img]

[b]●Spell Slot of the Wand[/b]
Based on everyone's feedback, we have optimized the issue of excessive spell slots exceeding the screen.
At the beginning of the game design, we thought that all the spell slots of the current wands were completely sufficient, especially with the Capacity Expansion Stone available. So we didn't have a particularly clear concept of the situation where too many spell slots would exceed the screen (We really didn't expect it). But with the gradual increase of spells and the continuous development of build by Magicians, we have found that even filling multiple Capacity Expansion Stones still cannot meet everyone's invention of build. So now the optimization of the wand spell slot has finally come out after much anticipation~
When there are too many spell slots that are about to exceed the screen, the spell slots in that column will automatically shrink, and will also shrink when the settlement screen pops up after completing the level.

[b]●Various Update[/b]
In future versions, the spell selection box will display different colors based on rarity, making it easier to identify which rarity the dropped spell belongs to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/dfa1aa60887fe7e0f4356f7fb01aabc3d1d0f106.png[/img]

We have also differentiated the blood bar frames of bosses from those of ordinary monsters, so don't bosses look more powerful now?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/6e3d841e508cd6942da000849fc0ceacf2408383.png[/img]

In addition to the above, we have also updated the UI of the save game screen. In the updated version, it will record more entries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/6a0e0df1dc0c7c0d79087d20b886ae2141f9c1e0.png[/img]

[b]●Game Performance Optimization[/b]
This part of the content has always been our top priority besides developing new content. Currently, the optimization is nearing completion and we have made good progress. In the future, we will provide a detailed explanation of the optimization related content for everyone after the game is launched (this can be considered as a small preview).
In short, the official version of Magicraft will feature higher performance and smoother gameplay to support your spell building.

That’s it for this developer log! If you have any suggestions, you can raise them in the comment or go to our Discord community (Discord：https://discord.com/invite/magicraft-1029926808516309093) for discussion. We look forward to your participation!

notes.content:

[b]In this release we have added quite a few new monster types and adjusted the summoning logic of the summoning series of spells based on feedback from you wizards! Everyone can enter the game to experience the new summoning magic~[/b]

------- adjusted -------
-Avada Gnawing Gourd will be unlocked in the icon and the training room according to the level.
-Added a description of what difficulty the monster appears in the icon.
-Summoners and other teammates no longer attack Abyssal Eyeballs and Abyssal Drags in the Abyss.
-Enhanced the death performance of trap crystal orbs, now they can be destroyed by indiscriminate damage.
-Reduced the price of Relic - Eight Sided Dice from 77 to 66.
-Highlighted Hourglass of Time triggers.
-Set upgrades will now be available once Chapter 4 is reached, instead of the Passing Difficulty.
-The Epic Spell Synthesis prompts directly that the level is full, instead of prompting that three are needed first.
-Knight's Breastplate no longer reduces the amount of blood consumed on puzzle levels
-Discount potions now discount the Uncursed Statue.
-Monster Ghost Vessel texture reset.
-Iterated Chapter 4 scene ground mapping
-Spell - Resonance Rune reset removes cooldown and adds a chance to cast the spell without consuming magic.
-Spirit name changed to Spirit
-Replaced the animation of Fusion Boing Boing/Self Magic Guide Book to avoid cracks.
-Adjusted the background effects of rare drops.
-The overheat of the spell Lightning Sprint will be cleared when the player passes through the door.
-Added up and down movement effects to the bat series.
-Iterated the sound effect of jumping ball, and lowered the probability of jumping ball mutation.
-Guardian Staff Spirit won't shoot when opening the synthesis screen, and optimised the logic of the Staff Spirit to stop shooting.
-New logic for Spell Refraction, Spell - Meteorite and Summoner - Boo Boo no longer refracts to the enemy if it doesn't hit someone.
-Some monsters will randomly attack and move without purpose when there is no target.
-The Curse-Hunting Snail curse has had a stroke added to it, so that it can still be seen even if it is blocked by the scene.
-If the Monster-Vine appears after a level is passed, it will close the door on the side
-Recast cost of Epic Spells adjusted from 30 to 25
-Guardian Scepter Spirit's amount of returned mana has been adjusted from 40/60/90 to 50/80/130.
-Ice Giant blood has been adjusted from 25,000 to 23,000, Pillar of Shadows 23,000 to 21,000, and Hand of the Abyssal Master 20,000 to 16,000.
-Spells - Flurry Scatter per spell fired adjusted from +10/10/10 to +10/15/20

-Soul Set Staff Spirit Level adjusted from 1 to 2, Soul Set Initial Staff Magic Return adjusted from 10 to 6.
-Significantly adjusted Staff - Staff of Innocence
-Spell Refraction changed to infinite range
-Spell - Corpse Explosion reduced in price with rarity, from 16 to 8
-Summon - Boo Boo Bomb's map size is now affected by the attack factor, but the actual blast effect is still affected by the radius of the impact.
-Knight's Helmet level cap has been adjusted from 1 to 2, and Undifferentiated Damage Reduction has been adjusted to 1%/0.3%.
-Kemono's Skull: Magic consumption adjusted from 50/92/160 to 50/80/130; Seconds damage adjusted from 16/28/46 to 16/20/26. 
-Skull of the Khertz: Adjusted from dealing 0/50%/100% of the staff's mana limit to dealing 0/10%/20% of the staff's mana limit.

-Spells - Forced Cooldown Cooling Effect adjusted from *70/50/20% to 60/30/15%

-Elite - Eye of Omniscience Chain Formation difficulty decreased.
-Modified some of the nastier levels
-Increased the frequency of the Elite Border Ghost's skills.
-Bone Spur Drill Bugs are more visible when moving.
-Nightmare Spider Safe Mode picture changed
-Boss sound effects, skills, performance adjustments, stage blood level adjustments
-Updated Chain Abuser look and artwork. 
-Illustrations optimised
-Iteration of some staff icons
-Optimised spell descriptions
-Translation optimisation
-Level optimisation

------- Fixes -------
-Fixes Guardian Staff Spirit firing spells indiscriminately before pointing at the target
-Fixes the issue where Curse - Ineffective Spellcasting would result in incorrect calculation of the summoner's mana consumption
-Fixes the issue where the handle cannot view the staff spell prompt information
-Fix the problem with the black border at the bottom of the scene in Chapter 4
-Fix the problem that the appearance of Fusion Boo Boo is wrong.
-Fix the problem that the handle and mouse can work together to brush spells infinitely.
-Fix the problem that the safe mode of the Skull of Kheri doesn't update the effect of the legs.
-Fixed the problem that Chief Skull did not come to the player's side after crossing the map but stayed in the relative position of the previous level.
-Fixed the issue where the logic of taking the highest magic return did not work when Guardian Staff Spirit was stacked.
-Fixed the issue of occasional ghostly jitters when the Skull of the Chief crosses the map and crosses the border of the third chapter.
-Fixed the issue where Boing Boing's collision body and firing position was one body position to the right, as well as a few other minor display issues.
-Fixed an issue where the Pillar of Light shadows were not displayed at the correct size.
-Fixed an issue where the Pillar of Light shadow was not following the body.
-Fixed the issue where the Pillar of Fused Light was permanently invincible after receiving an indiscriminate attack.
-Fixed the issue that the perspective of the Pillar of Fused Light is wrong in front and back.
-Fixed the issue where the collision body of the Fusion Tentacle does not change with the Fusion.
-Fixed the issue where the number of shots for the Fusion Book's Essence Special Casting was not increased by the Fusion Level.
-Fixed the issue where doors would not appear in certain situations in Chapter 4
-Fixed the issue where the movement back slot triggered by sprinting did not trigger resonance
-Fix the issue where two Staff Spirit Staffs can be exchanged to unlock the Staff Spirit Set.
-Fixed the issue where lightning bolts from Thunderbolt Formation would become straight lines.
-Fixed the issue where the Cruise Bone Worm could get stuck in a ball when knocked back.
-Fixed the issue where Monster - Void Vessel would not be detected by players using Spell - Lightning Blast.
-Temporarily fixed a bug in the English description of Arcane Nova.
-Fix too many words in Curse-Aphasia in English gameplay
-Fix the issue that after turning off the sound effect, the sound will still play a bit when the black hole is released.
-Fix the problem that the cooldown time on the staff on the ground may be displayed as a negative number.
-Fixes the rotation error that sometimes occurs with staff spirits
-Fixed the issue where long-tailed polypods were particularly prone to falling off cliffs
-Fixed an issue where the blood value of the Waddler was wrong
-Fixed the problem that some monsters have abnormal picture effects after being coloured.
-Fixed the problem that the Curse of the Spirit of Vengeance may be stuck in place.
-Fixed the problem that the Abyssal Peeper's chin is missing.
-Fixed the problem that the level of relics will exceed the upper limit under certain circumstances.
-Fixed the issue that under certain circumstances, random curses will lead to a decrease in shop items
-Fix the issue that SL will play one more level under certain circumstances.
-Fixes the issue that Endless Treasure Chest may cause the treasure chest to fly into the void in Chapter 3 and cannot be interacted with
-Fixed the issue that the initial life limit of fusion summons is fixed and will not be affected by the level of the summon.
-Fixed an issue with the English layout of the staff artwork.
-Fixed the issue where Fusion Summons could eat Split Reinforcement and split after death.
-Fixed the issue that the blood bar of the Fusion Magic Guide is in the wrong position.
-Fixed the issue where Spore Mushroom healing does not work.
-Fixed an issue with the Ice Giant Solitaire.

After this update, our development focus will be gradually put on the future version 1.0, we hope to be able to focus on the development of brand new content, but also need some time to increase the amount of various features currently available, so the frequency of large-scale updates in the next period of time will be reduced, I hope you understand ~!
Of course, we will also learn from our previous experience, maintain a stable frequency of communication with all wizards on various social media platforms, and from time to time, we will also do some development progress related to the picture penetration, and then we will also start the testing of new content, and we hope you can give us more advice~!

notes.title: 0.8 Version Major Update | Developer's Log 05 for Magicraft
notes.content:
[b]Dear Magicians:
In eager anticipation of fans on all platforms, the 0.8 version of Magicraft has reached the final stage of development and has already been updated![/b]
Although we have received many suggestions from users to release partial content first and then update gradually, our team still believes that content-rich and focused updates can provide a more complete and stable gaming experience than frequent but minimal updates. We really appreciate everyone for keeping you waiting for so long.
Now, let's introduce to you the exciting content in this version!

[b][h3]1. New Chapter - Abyss of Antiquity[/h3][/b]
As the magical prowess of all magicians continues to advance day by day, we have also taken another step forward and arrived at the chapter of Abyss of Antiquity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/76d71374e0f58037bdf0b59b037acf80aa9577a0.png[/img]
In the Abyss of Antiquity, players will encounter a host of new minions, elite minion, and bosses blocking their path. To ensure everyone's journey goes smoothly, we present a detailed chapter introduction for all magicians to peruse.


[b]●New Minion - Void Creatures[/b]
Void creatures are beings composed of void energy, possessing the ability to fade into the void to evade attacks. When encountering them, remember to approach closely to force them out of the void before launching attacks!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/959ced1dae4667e9a8bb99bf767ca1c41eeaa682.png[/img]

[b]●New Minion - Mana Absorber:[/b]
Mana Absorbers feed on the mental energy of sentient beings. When encountering them, be cautious in case they drain your magical power!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/1abfab0fd36b5312f3b33dfb96f5b063ca76aa39.png[/img]

[b]●New Minion - Thorny Bee:[/b]
Thorny Bees have incredibly high mobility and can unleash spiral attacks. Please be cautious and evade their attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/f387b574fd71ba1e1c35dd0762c5d5dfb5ded46b.png[/img]

[b]●New Minion - Poison Sac:[/b]
Poison Sacs possess high HP and can emit poisonous mists for attacks. You can try targeting and breaking its side eyeballs first to defeat the main body more quickly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/b561dae8c9fc0c30bbe186e91466264155599b96.png[/img]

[b]●New Minion - Shadow Pillar:[/b]
Shadow Pillars can provide shields for other minions in the same scene. Remember to prioritize attacking them first.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/86bcdd03079d206cea698c0a37bd0305f67c3706.png[/img]

[b]●New Minion: Ice Giant[/b]
Ice Giants can launch attacks similar to meteor strikes and wide-range ground pounds, causing a freezing effect upon impact. Please be mindful and dodge accordingly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/51bda4897e8bd19ffdf03238bd7b2d7620b454ec.png[/img]

For the remaining new interesting minions and mechanisms, feel free to explore them for yourself in-game!

[b]●New Elite Minion: Skeletal Centaur[/b]
File missing, no detailed introduction available. 
Magicians, please explore on your own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/07cb7fb2de51210754ebf009a55da8cafe912bf2.png[/img]

[b]●New Boss: Abyssal Lord[/b]
Abyssal Lord's attacks are all related to water-based magic. When mysterious characters on the ground light up, it seems to enter an invincible state.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/ab6342236400ba6d2f13e7c2984ef03934719cbe.png[/img]

[b][h3]2.New Spells[/h3][/b]
In this update, we've added 4 active attack spells, 1 enhancement spell, 1 passive spell, and 4 summoning spells, totaling 10. Please see below for detailed descriptions:

[b]●Active Attack Spell One: Sword of Judgment[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/27ef88bbf839e4e04df3486c6c11d68c2f095b8e.png[/img]
The Sword of Judgment rotates around players/wands upon casting for about 8 seconds, with a certain locking range. It will automatically attack when minions appear within the locking range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/a8e10ec7251928f259d0443879925e0475c22cfe.png[/img]

[b]●Active Attack Spell Two: Condensed Water Bubble[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/0d22b25926f515fd1f23888ebcc8f7a3cb682979.png[/img]
Upon casting, it gradually condenses into a bubble with an expanding radius over time. After a certain duration, the bubble explodes with a knockback effect. If enemy units are within the radius, the bubble explodes automatically. The damage and radius of the explosion increase with time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/9c6fa47e6505790e23af7b2d00245bfb88c722b6.png[/img]

[b]●Active Attack Spell Three: Fierce Dragon Breath[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/91cfad64ae8fe903c26a8645aba81d7597cfd3eb.png[/img]
Fierce Dragon Breath inflicts continuous damage, with damage increasing over time. Continuous casting also applies recoil.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/0eba654002ac8343a8f5f2494f9c320fe442ad26.png[/img]

[b]●Active Attack Spell Four: Shining Star Arrow[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/7add4608fc174c4165a2886afaa830c7b4b3ff4e.png[/img]
Shining Star Arrow can be casted with a single click or charged, requiring 4 charges to reach maximum.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/869558a51cd5850af45299c66b8c56497a47f8c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/e4a2d157eb9399b9e12c506d83fd233c2ddd8950.png[/img]

[b]●Enhancement Spell: Reflection[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/f48bd15cf92574cba5b7957bc7b51327a00b17b4.png[/img]
When the active spell hits an enemy, it reflectss twice when it fulfill the condition of being within 4 meters of the spell's ending range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/a1da25bcb7e4cb003397e3cccf0c82f82b25c53b.png[/img]

[b]●Survival Spell: Arcane Barrier[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/f3e60d6dbaba95ba2151dacfa8595af1bbff2a74.png[/img]
Arcane Barrier occupies 3 spell slots and can be used in an unarmed wand. When the wand is fully charged, it generates a barrier that can block damage and deal damage to nearby enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/1665796a0b4c4c142428e97ce114d0ebaf08a69d.png[/img]

[b]In player suggestions, we found that the summoning spells was generally considered weak. Therefore, we have strengthened the summoning branch and introduced exclusive summoning spells.  The summoning branch will be more interesting to play now.[/b]

[b]●Summoning Spell One: Cadaver Explosion[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/3537fea9f2c1b791be248f576902b1d2ab1d08ce.png[/img]
Cadaver Explosion increases the maximum HP of summoned creatures. When HP of summoned creatures is below 50%, they will self-explode with a explosion range of 2.4 meters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/dc340f83ee3e3c515429ece1fa4bed619d434417.png[/img]

[b]●Summoning Spell Two: Indomitability[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/2fc0acdc752104407470398cfc27c3f23334b3eb.png[/img]
Summoned creatures will not disappear after death and can continue fighting for 2 seconds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/8f51399033da593a5e64308df7f8c40104f3a777.png[/img]

[b]●Summoning Spell Three: Fusion Summon[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/bf536b75454122086b51ad91009d501517c48fe7.png[/img]
Fusion Summon requires 2 spell slots and merges two identical summoned creatures into one, enhancing the combat performance of them. For specific effects, please refer to the game for details.

[b]●Summoning Spell Four: Essence of Soul[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/7206deffc95de06cd94837f2270dadc79031ac75.png[/img]
Essence of Soul bestows new abilities upon summoned creatures:

①Essence of Bobo: Each attack of Bobo has a 20% chance to launch a Bo Bomb.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/e23f5b022dfa99babe34390e915892d907351e0b.png[/img]

②Essence of Hand of the Cthulhu: Increases attack speed by 10%. After every 4 attacks, Hand of the Cthulhu's attacks transform into a series of attacks, dealing damage to enemies in a straight line.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/effb5b8c9c9c324a729cb0e4be99120f3d339dcd.png[/img]

③Essence of Skull of the Cthulhu: Two sharp tentacles grow from skull of the Cthulhu .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/89676b5a037f94d44189008a78e8779ddb70d1d0.png[/img]

④Essence of Pillar of Light: The Pillar of Light gains levitation near the ground. When there are enemy units within a certain range of the Pillar of Light, it performs a shockwave attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/b21b4ed5560a4ec330d3d6d54c8b36e6284a1e85.png[/img]

⑤Essence of Autonomous Grimoire: The Autonomous Grimoire gains teleportation ability. When enemy units are detected on the map, it teleports to a suitable position (near enemy units).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/674f140e266caf1b6a6885b39e391f77a8277122.png[/img]

[b][h3]3. New NPC & Function[/h3][/b]
After the introduction of the Monster Girl "Lilia," we received widespread praise for this setting. Additionally, the function of choosing between three spells has to some extent addressed the issue of players unable to graduate from builds. However, based on some suggesttions, we learned that players were having trouble reforging spells they desired in the workshop.
Therefore,we have added a new Monster Girl with the highly requested function-Spell Disable. After successfully finishing the hard difficulty, players can rescue the new NPC "Gina" to unlock the Spell Disable function.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/bc7a6a35bb4a565a4a9242fdc60205612e496bb1.png[/img]

[b][h3]4. Encyclopedia Function Optimization[/h3][/b]
We have optimized the Encyclopedia display, providing detailed descriptions for monsters and spells, including their special mechanisms. Welcome all magicians to explore on your own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/534d62705bd48046dfc234ccb269cf798ff9a3fd.png[/img]

[b][h3]5. Future Development Plan[/h3][/b]
Next, we will complete Chapter Five in Nightmare Difficulty. After that, we will continue to fill in spells, relics, wands, curses, potions, and other content. We will also supplement and optimize NPC functions. Of course, as promised before, the Workshop and Endless Mode will be developed and community permissions will be opened after the formal content is completed!
Although there have been no large-scale updates in the past few months, we have recruited players to help us test while developing. By synchronously conducting development testing, we aim to further shorten the development cycle. We would like to express our sincere thanks to the players of the testing group for their dedication and hard work.
In the future, we will be more active on multiple platforms and communicate with all magicians to avoid concerns about disapearing again. Thank you all for your continued patience and support! Please believe in our determination to make the game excellent and complete. We will definitely not disappear!
Afterwards, we will also open recruitment for testing palyers in the official community next. Magicians who are interested in can join our Discord community for notifications. We hope that in thecoming days, we can continue to work hand in hand with all players and we also hope that all magicians can provide us with more suggestions and ideas to make our game even better.
So, this developer's log ends here! If you have any other questions or want to learn more official information, you can join our official Discord community! We are looking forward to you!

notes.title: [December Version Update] New Spells and Hidden Character Functions added~
notes.content:
[h3][b]Good evening, all you great wizards!

Sorry for the wait! The 2nd version update of Magicraft is finally here~[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]This will be an update to version 0.75 and will also bring you the following:

In the new version, we have added 250 new maps, 5 new spells, new NPC6, 2 new relics, 2 new curses, and other brand new content;[/b][/h3]

Also populated the Chapter 1 art with new pond effects for some of the Chapter 1 maps;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/f06bc0d95af91cd2c9801311a4e8382ecd3f594a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Remastered the story plot of Chapter 3 on Normal difficulty, and re-passed the level to unlock new NPCs and spells! [/b][/h3]

[b]This new spells were added because people wanted to increase the demand for spells that trigger new spells after the end of the fuse type, so we managed to introduce 4 new spells of this type after going through a heated discussion.
Because the original code logic is not enough to support the new spells, so we threw all the code into the forge for recasting, completely refactoring all the underlying logic, so it took a longer time, I hope you can forgive;[/b]

New Spell 1: Whirling Blade
A cyclopean flying blade can be thrown forwards, dealing damage to enemy units in its forward path, and dealing the same damage on its return. Upon returning to your hand, the Boomerang Flying Blade deals knockback to yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/0c0cf928bd34ed3b134fece41dd27e2da8e43d6b.png[/img]

Added Spell 2: Duet
Left and right nested spells, example for the following build. At the end of AoE, release Boomerang, the damage of Boomerang damage = AoE's damage 15*20% + Boomerang's own damage 12 = 15

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/283ab85fc901cc359fd8e1d65aa2d2006a7e3560.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/91e37cbb0e27c95e8564289437b0f71ee539e706.png[/img]

Added Spell 3: Gorgeous Fireworks
Left and right nested spells, same as the following build example. At the end of Orbital Blast, release boomerangs in 4 directions at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/131b782553ef1bc643871f7d033b0ddcc63253e6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/937a61131de76fb6bbe731e8a06c03231901ceb2.png[/img]

Added Spell 4: Echo
Left and right nested spells, example from the following build. When a Disintegration Ray hits an enemy, it will continuously release Echoing Flying Blades at 0.3 intervals. This spell is currently recommended to be built as a persistent spell as a left side spell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/923abe929f7e6faacd8bb883da53a8ae7e1e7ac7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/cc240f4e45ebeff820e7ff14df997f32f282b93a.png[/img]

New Spell 5: Chain
Left and right nested spells, example from the following build. During the flight of the black hole, it will continuously release a cyclopean flying blade, with an effect similar to the AoE Nova.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/974047364c07fd28dc358455ab5be9d882ce2df7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/c8ac96e9a42a166ec33d8873c97526c65cd6b0be.png[/img]

New NPC 6: Tentacle Girl
NPC function to unlock new spells and increase the range of spells available
The development of this feature stems from concerns about the gradual increase in spells and the dilution of the spell pool resulting in not being able to construct builds smoothly. We have added this feature after an active meeting and discussion, and we hope you can enjoy it. Of course, Tentacle will also have new features in future versions, please look forward to it~!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153223/0a8d9d9e2bfb6f81ab82cec6a655b03831c4ed65.png[/img]

We will continue to focus on the official version of the content, the development of the fourth chapter of the content, as well as the new difficulty - Nightmare Mode, as well as more new spells, new relics, will be accompanied by the version of the update and meet with you one by one, please wait for the great wizards ~!

As the content of Chapter 4 is brand new, it involves the drawing and construction of maps, and we expect to use new creations to enrich the game instead of just filling the first three chapters with small monsters. Therefore, the development time will be increased.
At the same time, because of the output of the fourth chapter, the nightmare mode also needs to be developed in tandem, at present we need to complete the difficult chapter four, nightmare chapter one, two, three, four can be considered as the next version of the development progress is completed. And, the nightmare variants of the chapter one, two and three monsters also need further support from the art, so, although there is no choice, we can only extend the development plan to about two months. We hope that the Great Wizards will bear with us and wait for our new content.

Of course, we will also continue to fill in the content not covered in the update roadmap based on your feedback. We look forward to developing more small features in the future to bring convenience to everyone's play.
As for the Endless Mode and Creative Workshop, we will start preparing for them as soon as the development of the official version of the game comes to an end.

The growth of Magicraft can not be separated from your support and companionship, I hope that in the days to come, you can still receive a steady stream of suggestions and feedback from the great wizards, we will certainly strive for excellence, and continue to challenge, to bring you a more delicious feast of magic!

This update also fixes a large number of bugs and optimises the experience, welcome to explore within the game:
Fix the problem that the bullets sprayed by the bloodsucking maggots could not hit the people.
Fix the issue that the joystick selecting level rewards may select the wrong location
Repair the problem that modifying the language after loading the level reward object is invalid.

The umbilical cord should be attached to the staff spirit when the staff spirit+umbilical cord+summoned object is used. 
Fixed the problem that the staff spirit still surrounds the player after releasing the umbilical cord. 
Fixed the issue that the umbilical cord is still linked to the player when the staff spirit is released. 
Fix the problem of incorrectly displaying the magic consumption of the subsequent spells of Chain and Echo. 
Fix the problem that the special effect of Black Hole does not disappear after being captured by elites. 
Repair the problem that spells cast by magic guide book are not affected by player's relics. 
Repair the problem that Nova + Boomerang causes the hit effects to be in an incorrect position 
Repair the bug that Troll Serum does not return blood
Fix bug where hovering + sprinting would only increase the duration without hovering

notes.title: 【Version Update】Initial Magic Sets, Leaderboards, and other features added~
notes.content:
Good evening, all you great wizards!

The first version update for Magicraft is finally here~ This will be an update to version 0.7 and will also bring you the following:

Two new initial magic sets have been added, which will be unlocked as the player progresses through the chapters he/she is playing~

Added the upgrade function of the initial magic sets, all the great wizards can further upgrade the sets through the currency gained to obtain more powerful magic!

Added the function of selectable staffs for the training ground, so you can choose freely during the test~!

Added 10 new monster behaviours and attack mechanisms in Hard Mode, so wizards who are confident in their own strength can take on the challenge again~!

Added time leaderboards in normal and hard modes, so that you wizards can compete for the fastest way through the level!
Hard Mode Leaderboards will be refreshed when the fourth map is added in version 0.8, so pay attention~!

Optimised the initial tutorial!
We've found that many players spend a lot of time trying to understand how spells work together in the game, so we've optimized the current version of the tutorial by adding text descriptions and dialogue to explain the relationship between spells, which will hopefully be helpful to all you wizards out there~!

There are many more optimisations to be made, so please feel free to experience them in the game~!

Bug fixes and optimisations:
Restricted the maximum width of the blood and magic bars. 
Shield potions now have a bonus limit. 
Fixed a bug where the Curse of the Old Pocket Watch would have a residual effect when it was removed during its duration of effect.
Fixed a bug where Relic Armour of Soul and Bone would remain on the field after being recast.
Added Harmony Mode for Vine Monsters 
Auto Wizard Book and Guardian Scepter Spirit can now pathfind on the Abyss. 
Fixed the bug where you couldn't enter a door due to random curses
Fixed the issue that the staff could not cast spells and had abnormal visual effects after removing power-up spells. 
Fixed the issue that when removing a staff with a power-up spell and it's powering up, the visual effects are abnormal and it's impossible to cast spells and interact with it 
Fixed a bug where mimicry cubes in the normal grid could mimic spells in the back grid.
Supported the transparency control function of relic "Bone Tail".
Fixed the bug that relics with altars would increase damage. 
The Uncurse Altar now has a maximum number of uses. 
Fixed the bug that tapping the altar quickly would result in free curse lifting and possible invincibility 
Added a dynamic effect to remind the long-lasting spell Lightning Rush when it is about to end.
Upgraded a small portion of Black Hole's effects so that even if it is completely covered by pits, you can still see the general range of Black Hole's effects. 
Increased the re-determination interval of Sprint Collision Box by 0.25 → 0.33. 
Fixed the issue where the extra magic limit of the Energy Stick was used to store the current magic instead of the magic limit.  
Fixed an issue where the information displayed when the Book of Wizardry was on the Staff on the Reward Selection Page was missing part of the information. 
When using the joystick to change the sound effect, you must toggle up in Menu - General: Language to reach it, not directly down from the language line. 
Added accent colours to dialogues 
Fixed the bug that sprinting in the training room would get stuck in the lower left corner. 
Downgraded some of the tiers of the lightning formation, so that it no longer blocks attacks from abyssals and monsters.
Fixed Gravitation not using the Strike Multiplier Relic bonus 
Fixed the issue that in extreme cases, the summoned relics will not disappear when the summoner dies during the summoning frame. 
Optimised game timer display 
Fixed the bug that caused the black screen of reading old files due to the suit.
Optimised the interface for obtaining staffs in the training ground 
Added a new texture when the altar is overused. 
Updated the style of unlocked treasure chests 
Built-in archive auto backup function 
Added automatic opening of backpack when getting items from the training ground

notes.title: 【1109】Bug Feedback Fixes
notes.content:
[h3][b]Thank you for your support of the game, we have been paying attention to the feedback from everyone in the community and have seen many questions asking about the content of subsequent releases, we have been catching up on our discussions lately and the game will be kept up to date with content for a long time to come.

Our team is limited in size, so we hope you'll give us some more time! The roadmap for the update you're all looking forward to is also being worked on as we catch up, and we welcome any and all Grand Wizards who enjoy our game to give us their valuable opinions, we can see them all![/b][/h3]

Now let's start with today's bug fixes~

Adjusted the effect of Magnifying Glass, which now boosts the radius of influence of spells and relics
Fixed an issue where dropping The Sensory Crown into an abyss could cause the character to disappear 
Fixed an issue where the spell Avada on the back grid would shoot to inexplicable points when triggered 
Fixed an issue that caused the black hole trailing to disappear in some cases (e.g. lag) 
Fixed umbilical cord knots staying in place and never disappearing in some cases 
Fixed an issue where the Split Water Gun would not trigger properly if it hit an enemy too accurately (the firing point was right on the enemy's body). 
Reduced the damage of monster shells bouncing bullets and cancelled the bludgeon rate. 
Some spells that are not affected by scatter no longer show the scatter modifier in the description panel. 
Fixed a bug where some effects were the wrong colour under semi-transparency 
Added anti-spider fear mode for some players who have a fear of spiders 
All-Seeing Eye now reacts correctly to stealthy players, with a slight adjustment to attack frequency
Fixed an issue where the flywheel monster would spin at high speed as soon as it appeared.
Fixed a small chance of permanent invincibility when the Unnamable Object spins in the second stage.
Fixed the occasional bug that summoned items had no upper limit. 
Fixed the issue that the Bone Spur Drill Bug is not shown in the artwork.
Fixed the problem with the incorrect volume of Petrifying Potion.
Adjusted the speed of the Surrounding Bat when it gets close to the player, preventing the player from not being able to get out of the surroundings at all 
Fixed the bug that ghosts have a probability of not moving outside the wall. 
Fixed the problem of black edges in demo version 
Removed the radius of influence for the spell "Levitate Ghost Fire", which is invalid for level 2 and 3, and reduced the magic consumption by 1 point for 2 stars and 2 points for 3 stars; slightly adjusted the self-splitting time; optimised the experience of using it.
Increased the self-destruct detection radius of the spell Parasite by 20%, to avoid the problem of Parasite not being able to explode due to its inability to get close to the centre of certain large-sized monsters. 
Fixed the issue that the spell Lightning Chain only applies to the first launchable spell in the back grid. 
Optimised the puzzle level Red, Green and Blue Room: now all pillars drop after completing the puzzle without having to turn around to get to them, and bricks don't rise when you step on the button again after passing the level 
Fixed an issue where the actual hit size of the fuse would not change with the body size. 
Optimised the puzzle levels with 9 choices of 2: 5 stones have been replaced with iron armour and 1 stone has been replaced with a wooden crate All arrays are now turned off after clearing the puzzles 
Fixed spell Book of Wizardry displaying an error message when it was on the back grid 
Fixed an issue where an error message was displayed when Level 2 and 3 Grams were located on the back grid 
Fixed the bug of error reporting when Tentacle Splitting occurs 
Fixed the bug that using the invincibility potion and then using the statue may cause permanent invincibility. 
Demon Sword can now slash monster shells with one slash 
Fixed the issue where the statue would be unavailable if used when there was not enough blood, but the price would also go up. Now the price will only go up when a curse is actually lifted.
